name: Debt Collectors
story: The hunters owe the tower a life, and the collectors have come to collect it.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Three collectors sit on the well. A hunter waits behind them with his hands bound.

beforeStory.speaker: Collector
beforeStory.text: He signed. We came. You can watch, or you can pay his share.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: They are not going to let him go no matter what you do.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The collectors count what they are owed and carry it back up the tower. The hunter is still bound.

afterStory.speaker: Hunter
afterStory.text: The ledger is not closed. There is a second page.

name: The Blood Ledger
story: The ledger room has one rule: sign it the way we do, without the crown's tricks.

beforeStory.speaker: Collector
beforeStory.text: Leave the skills at the door. If you can take the page off this table, it is yours.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The room is empty except for the table, the ledger, and three men who have done this before.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith takes the page. The collectors step back and let him keep it.

afterStory.speaker: Collector
afterStory.text: The signature is missing. It is not a debt until someone signs.

name: Final Payment
story: The debt is paid in full. The master offers Arith a place in the ledger.

beforeStory.speaker: Debt Master
beforeStory.text: The page is yours. The debt is not. Sign it, and the debt becomes somebody else's.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Mara waits outside the ledger room. The door is not wide enough for a witness.

beforeStory.speaker: Debt Master
beforeStory.text: Bring nobody. The ledger takes one name at a time.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The master's name goes into the page. The room keeps the rest.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Under the page there is a second list, older than the debt. Arith copies one line into his hand and leaves.

name: The Hour They Kept
story: Two keepers hold the same hour, and neither will let it end.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Two keepers stand at the bell rope. They strike the same hour again and again.

beforeStory.speaker: Hour Keeper
beforeStory.text: The hour is not finished. Stay until it is.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: One keeper lowers the rope. The other is still counting.

name: Two of One Hour
story: The rope asks for one pair of hands, and the keepers will not lend theirs.

beforeStory.speaker: Hour Keeper
beforeStory.text: Take the rope alone. Two hands would put the hour out of order.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Mara waits on the stairs. The bell keeps ringing through the door.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The rope goes slack. Somewhere below, the hour finally moves on.

name: The Thirteenth Ring
story: There is a thirteenth ring. The keepers will not say who it is for.

beforeStory.speaker: Hour Keeper
beforeStory.text: The bell asks for no skills. Ring it the way the first keeper did.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The chamber is full of ringers, all of them waiting for someone else to pull.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The thirteenth ring sounds. No one gets up afterwards.

afterStory.speaker: Hour Keeper
afterStory.text: You kept the hour. Keep the rope, too.
